response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(c.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN c.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND c.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN c.gbsize END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND c.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN c.spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), av AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gpm FROM per) SELECT per.status, per.total_scans, per.gb_per_min, per.gb_per_min - av.avg_gpm AS excess_over_avg FROM per, av WHERE per.gb_per_min > av.avg_gpm
